gen.box_exclude_tip: Stops OCR from reading its own translation and hides it from recordings (Windows 10 2004+).
gen.interval_tip: The image only goes through OCR if it changed; the interval just sets the check frequency.
gen.material_tip: Windows 11 Mica/Acrylic. Other systems automatically use a solid background.
gen.motion_tip: Reduces motion for comfort and lower GPU use.
gen.topmost: Keep the main window always on top
main.alphabet_tip: Alphabet of the game text (sets the OCR language).
main.ct_tip: Clicks pass through Box Mode (Windows). Untick here to interact with it again.
main.interval_tip: Time between captures (0.2–5 s). Lower = faster, more CPU.
main.now_tip: Captures and translates once, right away (F6 or global hotkey).
main.ocr_tip: OCR engine. See Options > OCR to install others.
main.start_tip: Toggles continuous translation (F5 or global hotkey).
main.unsupported_alpha: This OCR engine cannot read that alphabet — pick another engine.
manual.err_nodevice: Microphone unavailable (PyAudio installed? mic plugged in?).
manual.listen_tip: Reads the translation aloud (gTTS, needs internet).
manual.mic_tip: Records from the microphone (needs SpeechRecognition + PyAudio).
ocr.contrast_tip: Autocontrast (and CLAHE if OpenCV is installed).
ocr.tess_missing: ✖ Tesseract not found. Install it (UB Mannheim) or click Browse.
rep.keep: Glossary: names that must NOT be translated
rep.rules: Replace rules (fix OCR text before translating)
rep.rules_tip: E.g. replace "rn0w" with "now". Use Regex for patterns. Aa = case sensitive.
status.cache_tip: {n} translations stored in the local cache.
status.latency_tip: Average OCR + translation time of the last cycle.
tr.argos_missing: Not installed. Install: pip install argostranslate
tr.cache_stats: {n} stored translations · {hits} total hits · session rate {rate}% · {live} online · {err} failures
tr.keys_note: Keys stay on this computer only, in {path} (never inside the project).
